_comment: Tax rule register and parameters. Every parameter the engine uses lives here so that rules can be updated without changing code. 'verification' states honestly how well the rule was checked: PRIMARY_READ = official text read; SECONDARY = reported by a secondary source only; UNVERIFIED = recalled, not yet checked against the official text. The application shows every rule that is not PRIMARY_READ as 'requires verification' in the Rules screen and in the Word report. Update date_checked when you verify a rule.

rules.topic: Conversion of non-AED amounts to AED
rules.summary: Where books are kept in a currency other than AED, amounts are converted using, in order of preference: (a) CBUAE spot rate on the transaction date; (b) CBUAE monthly average where (a) is impractical and the result is an acceptable approximation; (c) CBUAE annual average. One method must be applied consistently; the reason, rates and mechanism must be recorded.
rules.source: FTA Decision No. 13 of 2023 (conversion conditions), effective 1 June 2023
rules.note: Read in an unofficial translation hosted on taxo.online; confirm against the official FTA text.

rules.summary: Realised and unrealised gains/losses in the financial statements are taxable by default. With the realisation-basis election only realised amounts are taxed. Election is available to accrual-basis businesses, must be made in the first Tax Period, and is irrevocable without FTA approval; not electing in the first period is treated as an irrevocable election not to use it. Two scopes exist: (A) all assets/liabilities subject to fair value or impairment accounting; (B) assets and liabilities held on capital account only.
rules.source: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 Art. 20(3); Ministerial Decision No. 134 of 2023 (Art. 8(3)); FTA Corporate Tax Guide - Determination of Taxable Income (31 Jul 2024) s.4.3, 4.3.1
rules.note: Read from the FTA guide (first ~41 pages). The guide does not itself label scopes 'Option 1/2'; the tool maps Option 1 = scope A, Option 2 = scope B, Option 3 = no election (matching the supplied template).

rules.summary: Transitional adjustments for pre-tax-period assets/liabilities (qualifying immovable property, intangibles, financial assets/liabilities). Never claimed automatically.
rules.source: Ministerial Decision No. 120 of 2023 (cited in FTA guide pp.14, 17)
rules.note: Existence confirmed via FTA guide citation; content not yet read.

rules.summary: 0% on taxable income up to AED 375,000 and 9% above; QFZP: 0% on Qualifying Income and 9% on non-qualifying income (no AED 375,000 band).
rules.note: Standard knowledge; verify against the MoF text before relying on it.

rules.summary: Resident person whose revenue in the current and all previous tax periods is AED 3m or less may elect relief (taxable income treated as nil). Not available to QFZPs or members of MNE groups with consolidated revenue of AED 3.15bn or more. Election forfeits carry-forward of tax losses and disallowed net interest from the election period. Originally for periods ending on or before 31 Dec 2026; reported extended to periods ending on or before 31 Dec 2029 by Ministerial Decision No. 131 of 2026.
rules.source: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 Art. 21; Ministerial Decision No. 73 of 2023; Ministerial Decision No. 131 of 2026 (extension - reported)
rules.note: Deloitte (MD 73) and DP Taxation article dated 26 Jul 2026 (MD 131). The MoF primary text of MD 131/2026 has not been read.

rules.summary: 0% on Qualifying Income only if all conditions are met (adequate substance, qualifying income, de minimis, transfer pricing, audited financial statements). De minimis reported as lower of AED 5m or 5% of revenue. Holding of shares/securities for investment is a qualifying activity (12-month uninterrupted holding reported). MD 229 and 230 of 2025 replaced MD 265 of 2023 retroactively from 1 June 2023. Free-zone registration alone never confers QFZP status.
rules.source: Cabinet Decision No. 100 of 2023; Ministerial Decisions No. 229 and 230 of 2025; MD 84 of 2025 (audit requirement)
rules.note: Summarised by China Briefing; MD 229 located on mof.gov.ae but not read. Thresholds and the 12-month condition must be verified.

rules.summary: Net interest expenditure deductible up to the greater of AED 12m and 30% of tax EBITDA. FX gains/losses accruing from interest are treated as interest.
rules.source: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 Art. 30; Ministerial Decision No. 126 of 2023 (cited in FTA guide s.4.6.1.5)

rules.summary: Dividends and gains on a Participating Interest are exempt if conditions are met (minimum ownership, holding period, subject-to-tax test). Dividends from UAE resident juridical persons are exempt. Related expenses are not deductible.
rules.source: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 Arts. 22-24; Cabinet Decision No. 116 of 2023
rules.note: Conditions in params are placeholders to be verified; the tool never applies the exemption unless every condition is answered Yes.

rules.summary: 50% of entertainment, amusement and recreation for customers, shareholders, suppliers or business partners is non-deductible; donations to non-qualifying public benefit entities, fines and penalties (other than compensation), bribes, dividends to owners, owner withdrawals, corporate tax, recoverable input VAT, and expenditure not wholly and exclusively for the business are non-deductible.
rules.source: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 Arts. 28, 33; template rows 33-48

rules.summary: Tax losses can be carried forward indefinitely; utilisation is limited to 75% of taxable income of the period.
rules.note: Cap also reflected in the supplied template (rows 60-61).

rules.summary: Transactions with Related Parties and Connected Persons must be at arm's length; disclosure and documentation thresholds apply.
rules.note: Thresholds deliberately not coded until verified.

rules.summary: Return due within nine months of the end of the Tax Period.
rules.source: Reported in Deloitte / DP Taxation SBR articles; FTA CT returns guide
rules.note: Penalty computation is out of scope.
